name: agent-toolkit-for-aws
description: Official, AWS-supported MCP servers, skills, and plugins to help AI agents build on AWS
one_liner: A free, official AWS-made toolkit that teaches AI coding assistants how to correctly set up and deploy things on Amazon's cloud, instead of guessing.
buyer: An agency or freelance developer who builds on AWS for clients and wants their AI assistant to stop making expensive cloud-architecture mistakes.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop installs the toolkit so its AI coding assistant stops suggesting outdated or insecure AWS setups for client projects.
A startup's one DevOps engineer uses the 'startup advisor' plugin to get AWS cost and architecture guidance it can't afford to hire a consultant for.
A security-focused agency uses the devsecops plugin to have an agent run vulnerability scans and penetration tests on AWS workloads it manages for clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid AWS architecture/cost audits where you run the agent toolkit against a client's AWS account and deliver a cleanup report.
Package it into a managed 'AWS copilot' service for small businesses who have no in-house cloud expertise.

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'AWS cost and security checkup' service for small businesses, using this toolkit to do the AI-assisted legwork in an afternoon.
